node.title: Re^7: Validating an XML file with multiple schemas
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
I've worked with XML a fair amount and written some Schemas myself, but it seems I hadn't come across something as (seemingly) complex as you're describing :-) Anyway, there are of course [https://metacpan.org/search?q=xml+schema|other modules] you could try out and see if they work for you, I just don't have any experience with them. Other than that, if you do end up having to go the route of calling an external validator, then my module [mod://IPC::Run3::Shell] might be of interest. Here's an example I adapted from one of my older projects where I call an external [man://xmllint] (this was before I had figured out the [id://1228074|above] solution using [mod://XML::LibXML]):

use IPC::Run3::Shell ':FATAL', [ xmllint => qw/ xmllint --noout --nonet --path /, $external_schemas_path, '--schema']; my $pass = eval { xmllint($schema, $file); $?==0 }; print $file, ": ", $pass ? "PASS" : "FAIL", "\n";

The module also offers ways to capture STDOUT and STDERR if you want to suppress and/or inspect that.

If the external validator is Java, then I've played around with [mod://Inline::Java], and it seems to work ok too.
